notes.notes:
The launch of complex 629 has been great so far but as it goes there have been some bugs.

[list]

notes.title: The release of Complex 629
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497075/fde0187997441dbb4b25a513ef383b27beaa270f.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]HI I'm Lillex :D[/b][/p][p]A year has now passed since I started work on this game and it has been one of the most fulfilling years of my life. This game Is a story that took forum a while ago but truly became its own within this medium. And you know what, I don’t think it could have been told in any other way. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Join my mailing list so you don't miss my next project![/b][/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/dAoYvY9eA3KaX4yw8"]https://forms.gle/dAoYvY9eA3KaX4yw8[/url][/p][p][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497075/b0d8da80b1257798e27cfbc55fb37e68e9377033.png"][/img][/p][p][b]What you can expect:[/b][/p][p]You will take control over a character named blue. You will begin outside an apartment complex in the middle of a blizzard and to begin with your goal is to head inside. You will be able to converse with the residents of this place on your way but what lies ahead? Well, Monsters probably but also a story about remembering and forgetting.[/p][p]
[/p][p]I hope you enjoy what I've put together along with my brother who did all the music. And I hope I can show you something interesting and new. But most of all I hope you felt something while inn there amongst the descendants of Complex 629.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]What's next?[/b][/p][p]I will be attending to this game as it launches. Bugfixes if needed, balance patches etc. but once that is done I’ll be scurrying off to work on the next instalment of this game creation journey. I cant say much about that yet but I will be making this a 3D game. Join the mailing list if you want to be notified once it gets announced! [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Major DEMO update
notes.notes:
Complex 629 demo 0.21 update log

Complex 629 is currently in development alongside this demo. The main game development progress is going well and the state of this update reflects the Features and visuals intended for the release of the full game. Enjoy the first chapter of complex 629 in its first major update!

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Additions:

[list]
[*] [i]Added hiding places[/i]
[*] You can now hide yourself away from the grandfather but in return he searches with more intent 
[*] [i]New NPC interactions[/i]
[*] Keep an eye out for new NPC placements throughout the Complex
[*] [i]New Junior dialogue [/i]
[*] The story and dialogue of Junior has been completely overhauled
[*] [i]New Title screen[/i]
[*] [i]New Sound effects[/i]
[*] [i]Shop now has reroll cost randomiser[/i]
[/list]

Changes:
[list]
[*] [i]Changed layout in entrance[/i]
[*] Spend less time in the entrance and spend more time exploring the complex
[*] [i]Changed layout in complex propper[/i]
[*] Navigation has been streamlined and each area has purpose 
[*] [i]Moved Apartment locations[/i]
[*] Apartments have been placed in more advantageous locations for exploration and navigating around the grandfather
[*] [i]Grandfather aggression balance changes[/i]
[*] The grandfather now moves with more determination
[*] [i]Piotr Apartment made more distinct [/i]
[*] There is cigarette ash everywhere dawg
[/list]


[b]User experience[/b]
Additions:
[list]
[*] [i]A robust tutorial[/i]
[*] [i]Tooltips[/i]
[*] [i]Respawning simplified[/i]
[*] [i]There is now only one pay gate[/i]
[/list]

Changes:
[list]
[*] [i]menu/inventory more user friendly[/i]
[*] [i]Dialogue screen has been updated[/i]
[*] [i]Piotr camera widened[/i]
[/list]

	Fixes
[list]
[*] [i]Cashier menu made more readable[/i]
[*] [i]Magnum opus menu made more readable[/i]
[*] [i]Hands no longer become inactive if items are sold while held[/i]
[*] [i]Grandfather not seeing the player when in agro level 3[/i]
[/list]

[b]This update contains a myriad of other tweaks and changes not listed above[/b]
